routine.title: OCC PR Review Queue and Weekly Quality Sweep
routine.monday_leg: On Monday, also report prior-week main-branch quality trends, dependency/CVE findings, and one tooling improvement.

invocation.command: /usr/local/bin/onecli run -- node tools/occ-fleet-cqe/src/collect.mjs --collector-sha $COLLECTOR_SHA --run-issue $RUN_ISSUE --repository-owner misterbusiness1 --output fleet-cqe-coverage.v1.json --summary fleet-cqe-coverage.md
invocation.collector_sha_contract: COLLECTOR_SHA must be the immutable merged commit containing this collector

reversibility.routine_change: Remove only the collector invocation from the existing Monday quality-sweep leg; do not delete or disable the routine.
reversibility.source_change: Revert tools/occ-fleet-cqe/ in a later repository commit.
